summary: Visit Saudi says the tourist eVisa is a multiple-entry visa valid for one year or a single-entry visa valid for three months, each allowing a stay of no more than 90 consecutive days, with medical insurance included in the visa price, and that the visa on arrival is also available to holders of used US, UK or Schengen business or tourist visas. It says GCC nationals do not need a visa, lists an Embassy/Consulate/Tasheer visa for others, and says Hajj needs a specific Hajj visa.

notes: The UK FCDO lists alcohol, pork and pork products, pornographic material, distillery equipment, weapons and narcotics among the items it is illegal to import.

The UK FCDO says there is zero tolerance for drug offences in Saudi Arabia: possessing even small amounts can bring a prison sentence of up to 5 years and a fine of 30,000 Saudi riyals, and drug dealing and smuggling can result in a death sentence.

safety.text: The UK FCDO says that since 13 July the Houthis have launched missiles and drones targeting several locations in Saudi Arabia, with a heightened threat against airports, military bases, ports and energy infrastructure including Abha, Jizan, Najran, Riyadh, Jeddah and Yanbu, and advises following Saudi Civil Defence alerts. It advises against all travel within 10km of the border with Yemen and all but essential travel to Aseer, Riyadh, Najran and Jizan provinces and Taif. It says the crime rate is low but there is petty crime, and that Islamic law is strictly enforced.

tips.text: Do not bring alcohol into Saudi Arabia or arrive under its influence. The UK FCDO says it is illegal to drink alcohol or be drunk in public, and that brewing, possessing or selling alcohol can bring severe penalties, including prison.

The UK FCDO says men and women must wear loose-fitting clothing that covers the elbow and below the knees, and to avoid clothing with profane slogans or images or with political symbols or slogans. Female travellers do not have to wear an abaya or cover their hair.
The UK FCDO says that during Ramadan you should not eat, drink, smoke or chew gum in public in the daytime, including in your car, or play loud music or dance.

faq.question: Do US citizens need a visa for Saudi Arabia?
faq.answer: Yes. The United States is on the eVisa terms' list of Permitted Countries whose citizens may apply for the tourist eVisa, and Visit Saudi says eVisa-eligible travellers can also get a visa on arrival at a kiosk or passport control. Visit Saudi gives the price as SAR 395 with medical insurance included, and the visa as multiple-entry for one year or single-entry for three months, with stays of no more than 90 consecutive days.

faq.question: How much does the Saudi tourist eVisa cost?
faq.answer: Visit Saudi gives SAR 395 (about USD 105.32), with the application fee and medical insurance included. If you qualify only through a GCC residence permit or a US, UK or Schengen visa or residence permit, it lists SAR 339.44 (about USD 90.50), with medical insurance not included.

faq.question: Can I get a Saudi visa on arrival with a US, UK or Schengen visa?
faq.answer: Visit Saudi says holders of a US, UK or Schengen business or tourist visa that has been used at least once, with an entry stamp from the issuing country (digital entry stamps are not accepted), and holders of a UK, US or EU permanent residence permit can apply for a visa on arrival at passport control.

faq.question: Can I perform Umrah on a tourist eVisa, and what vaccinations do pilgrims need?
faq.answer: Visit Saudi says the tourist visa can be used to perform Umrah but not during the Hajj season, and that Hajj requires a specific Hajj visa through the Ministry of Hajj and Umrah. The Ministry of Health requires everyone intending to perform Umrah to be vaccinated against meningococcal meningitis (serogroup ACYW), at least 10 days before arrival; individuals from the countries its regulations list must provide a certificate.

faq.question: Is alcohol allowed in Saudi Arabia?
faq.answer: No. The UK FCDO lists alcohol among the items it is illegal to import and says not to bring alcohol into Saudi Arabia. It says it is illegal to drink alcohol or be drunk in public, and that you can face severe penalties, including prison, for brewing, possessing or selling alcohol.

entryRequirements.customs.currencyLimits.text: It is a compulsory procedure required for each traveler to or from the Kingdom, in case they have any currency, monetary instruments, gold bullions or precious metals, precious stones, fine jewelry valued at SR 40,000 or more.
Filling out the declaration form electronically can be done through the smartphone application or the Authority's website.

If the declared goods/items are currencies or bearer negotiable tools or precious metals worth 40,000 SAR, or if they are restricted or prohibited goods, the traveler is required to visit the declaration office at the port to complete the declaration procedures, even after having completed the declaration process electronically.

entryRequirements.customs.notes.1.text: There is zero tolerance for drug offences in Saudi Arabia, and the penalties are severe.
You can get a prison sentence of up to 5 years and a fine of 30,000 Saudi riyals for possessing even small amounts. Drug dealing and smuggling can result in a death sentence.

countryFacts.safety.text: Since 13 July, the Houthis (a military group in Yemen) have launched missiles and drones targeting several locations in Saudi Arabia. There is a heightened threat against airports, military bases, ports and energy infrastructure across Saudi Arabia, including Abha, Jizan, Najran, Riyadh, Jeddah and Yanbu
all travel to within 10km of the border with Yemen all but essential travel to Aseer province, Riyadh province, Najran province, Jizan province and Taif city and Taif International Airport.
The crime rate in Saudi Arabia is low, but there is petty crime.
Saudi Arabia is a Muslim country and Islamic law is strictly enforced.

countryFacts.bestTimeToVisit.text: Saudi Arabia faces extreme heat, especially in the summer between May and October, with temperatures well above 40°C.

Once you arrive at your destination’s airport or entry point in Saudi, use the self-service devices (KIOSK) or go directly to the passport control office to apply for your visa on arrival.

U.S., U.K. or Schengen Visa Holders can qualify for visa on arrival if the below conditions are met: Your visa must be a business or tourist visa. Your visa must have been used at least once and have an entry stamp from the issuing country (Digital entry stamp are not accepted).
Residents from the U.K, U.S. and EU can apply for a visa on arrival if the below conditions are met: You must hold a permanent residence permit from a country located in the U.K., U.S. or EU.

visaTypes.eta.feeNotes.text: Tourism, business, study, medical treatment, and Umrah. The Electronic Travel Authorization cannot be used for employment or Hajj.

visaTypes.visa-waiver.feeNotes.text: The application must be submitted while the visitor is outside the Kingdom. The approval process takes up to 24 hours and will be sent to applicants via email. Print the approval and present it upon arrival.
